files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
Includes also everything from 1.3.3-rc1 to 1.3.3-rc3 below.

### Fixed

- Keep the CardDAV error in fallback login mode
- Do not use git+ssh for dependencies in package.json
- Updated translations from Transifex
- Updated the build-system submodule


### Added

- PR #108, configurable connect and request timeouts in the admin settings
- PR #93, login modes with the Roundcube login form as fallback
- PHP 8.3 support (supported range is now 8.3 - 8.5)
- PHPUnit and Vitest tests, wired into CI

### Changed

- Migrated the build and release process to the shared
  nextcloud-app-build-system, PRs #100, #101
- Updated translations from Transifex

### Fixed

- #72 by PR #108, requests to Roundcube could hang indefinitely as
  only POST requests had a timeout
- Migrate the legacy "allow manual login" setting to the login mode
- Missing personal email login field
- Unset admin text settings
- Do not return personal email passwords, handle stored passwords
  safely in the personal settings UI


### Added

- PR #58, manual login option
  - if enabled then now the logout button is also visible
- PR #55, add support for client TLS

### Fixed

- #79 by PR #80, invalidate old app passwords
- #76, 77 by PR #78, logout request token and URL building in sendRequest()
- scaling of Roundcube frame on narrow mobile devices, PR #65
- checkboxes in admin-settings were broken
- "show top line" (rather the logout button) option was broken
